cases.name: Accepted but unshipped projection has zero realized revenue
Date, warehouse and selected Sales isolate pending work and immutable order attribution
Two current confirmed issue documents count once each while draft invoices and another warehouse are excluded
Handover changes current customer access while old and new sales remain attributed to their captured Sales and dates
Referral conversion and revenue use the selected registration cohort, order period and warehouse without exceeding 100%
Admin-all and each Sales use the same original-referral cohort denominator after a handover
Locked Sales remain in Admin historical reports while assignment lists exclude unavailable identities
A requested but unreceived return does not reduce realized revenue
Only actually received return dispositions reduce the original Sales gross once per returned unit
Multiple payment receipts do not multiply invoice or return projection amounts
Admin aggregate order revenue stays inside the current internal organization warehouse scope
